places.name: Maybunga Rainforest Park
places.line_fil: Parke sa Maybunga na may water park, butterfly house, boating, gym at picnic area.
places.line_en: A park in Maybunga with a water park, butterfly house, boating, gym and picnic area.
places.address: F. Legaspi St., Maybunga, Pasig City
places.hours_fil: Lunes hanggang Linggo, 7:00 n.u.–5:00 n.h., maliban sa mga holiday (abiso noong Nob. 11, 2025)
places.hours_en: Monday to Sunday, 7:00 AM–5:00 PM, except on holidays (advisory of Nov. 11, 2025)
places.fee_fil: PHP 100 ang bayad sa water park para sa mga adult na taga-Pasig. Magdala ng ID na may address sa Pasig.
places.fee_en: Water park: PHP 100 for a Pasig-resident adult (ID with a Pasig address required)

places.name: RC Park sa Maybunga Rainforest Park
places.line_fil: May putik, tubig at mga hadlang sa bagong lugar para sa RC car. Puwede ring pumunta ang mga hindi taga-Pasig.
places.line_en: A new park for remote-controlled cars with mud, water and obstacles; open to non-residents too.
places.address: Sa loob ng Maybunga Rainforest Park, F. Legaspi St., Maybunga, Pasig City

places.name: Plaza Rizal
places.line_fil: Plasa sa poblacion ng Pasig, katabi ng Pasig City Museum at ng Katedral ng Pasig.
places.line_en: A plaza in Pasig's poblacion, beside the Pasig City Museum and Pasig Cathedral.
places.address: Plaza Rizal, F. Concepcion St., Pasig City

places.name: Katedral ng Pasig (Immaculate Conception Cathedral)
places.line_fil: Simbahang itinatag ng mga Agustino noong Hulyo 2, 1573, kasabay ng pagkatatag ng bayan ng Pasig.
places.line_en: A church founded by the Augustinians on July 2, 1573, together with the town of Pasig.

places.name: Pasig City Museum
places.line_fil: Muling binuksan ang museo sa dating Concepcion Mansion noong Marso 26, 2025. Libre ang pagpasok.
places.line_en: The museum in the old Concepcion Mansion reopened on March 26, 2025; entry is free.
places.address: Plaza Rizal, F. Concepcion St., Pasig City
places.hours_fil: Martes hanggang Linggo, 9:00 n.u.–4:00 n.h. Magpa-appointment para sa guided tour tuwing Sabado at Linggo.
places.hours_en: Tuesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM; guided tours on Saturdays and Sundays, by appointment

places.name: Bahay na Tisa
places.line_fil: Ito ang pinakamatandang gusaling nakatayo pa sa Pasig. Itinayo ito noong 1846 at pag-aari ng pamilyang Tech.
places.line_en: The oldest standing building in Pasig; built in 1846 and owned by the Tech family.

places.name: Kapitolyo Food District
places.line_fil: May mga kilalang kainan at café sa Kapitolyo, na dating sentro ng lalawigan ng Rizal. Nagkaroon dito ng Gastro Tour noong 2025.
places.line_en: A known strip of restaurants and cafés in Kapitolyo, once the Rizal provincial seat; a Gastro Tour ran in 2025.

places.name: East Bank Linear Park at Skate Park
places.line_fil: Binuksan noong Pebrero 27, 2025 ang unang skate park ng Pasig at linear park sa Manggahan Floodway.
places.line_en: Pasig's first skate park and a linear park along the Manggahan Floodway opened on February 27, 2025.
places.address: East Bank Road, Manggahan Floodway, Barangay Sta. Lucia, Pasig City

places.name: Parke ng Pag-asa
places.line_fil: Maliit na luntiang lugar sa Ortigas na itinampok noong Earth Day, Abril 22, 2025.
places.line_en: A small urban green space in Ortigas unveiled on April 22, 2025, Earth Day.
places.address: Doña Julia Vargas Street corner Meralco Avenue, Ortigas, Brgy. San Antonio, Pasig City

places.name: Ilaya Buting Linear Park
places.line_fil: Binuksan ang ikatlong linear park ng Pasig noong Oktubre 8, 2026. May palaruan, basketball court at ilaw.
places.line_en: Pasig's third linear park, inaugurated on October 8, 2026, with a playground, basketball court and lighting.
